summary: Some settings exist in both gateway and controller and must be kept consistent manually: MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH and ORG_ADMINS_CAN_SEE_ALL_USERS (gateway under Settings > Platform gateway, controller under Settings > Automation Execution > System). ALLOW_OAUTH2_FOR_EXTERNAL_USERS is authoritative in gateway only.
questions: Which settings must be kept in sync between gateway and controller?
Does controller follow gateway settings for org admins?

answer_card.title: Settings duplicated in gateway and controller
answer_card.answer_md:
| Setting | Gateway | Controller |
|---|---|---|
| `MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH` | Settings > Platform gateway | Settings > Automation Execution > System |
| `ORG_ADMINS_CAN_SEE_ALL_USERS` | Settings > Platform gateway | Settings > Automation Execution > System |
| `ALLOW_OAUTH2_FOR_EXTERNAL_USERS` | Settings > Platform gateway | n/a |

Keep the first two the same in both; direct controller API workflows use the controller's value.
